Suite/Test/Step Name: Test Cases/KPE-Automated/TC02 - Login with Invalid Password
Description: Automated regression test verifying that login is rejected when a valid username is paired with an incorrect password, and that an error message is displayed.
Step 1: Navigate to the login page

Suite/Test/Step Name: setText(findTestObject("03 - AI-Generated - KAI/AI-Generated/Katalian Banking Production/Page_login/input_secureId"), username)
Description: Step 2: Enter the username into the Secure ID field

Suite/Test/Step Name: setText(findTestObject("03 - AI-Generated - KAI/AI-Generated/Katalian Banking Production/Page_login/input_accessCode"), password)
Description: Step 3: Enter an incorrect password into the Access Code field
Step 4: Click the Enter Vault Access (Login) button
Step 5: Verify the user remains on the login page (login rejected) - the username field should still be present

Suite/Test/Step Name: Test Cases/KPE-Automated/TC03 - Login with Empty Credentials
Description: Automated regression test verifying that clicking Login with empty username and password fields does not navigate away from the login page.
Step 1: Navigate to the login page
Step 2: Click the Enter Vault Access (Login) button without entering any credentials
Step 3: Verify the user remains on the login page (login blocked) - the username field should still be present
